description: This file contains unit tests for location helper functions `formatLocationText` and `toLocationContext`. It verifies the formatting of location strings and the construction of context objects based on location data.

methods.name: formatLocationText
methods.description: Formats a location object into a human-readable string, handling different location attributes such as accuracy, name, address, caption, and live location status.

methods.name: toLocationContext
methods.description: Converts a location object into a context object with standardized field names for easier processing.
